plan.archetype: Efficient attacks transitioning into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade damage and Neutralize; establish reliable poison and dexterity-backed block. Cross the 160-HP stun threshold promptly; prepare strong single-card Ringing turns and defensive potions.
plan.summary: Spend gold on early damage, efficient defense, and draw. Add poison before acceleration. Replace Strikes before removing them; Greed cannot be removed. Fight elites only with strong cards and potion support.

plan.archetype: Dexterity-backed poison with efficient attack support
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Predator, Footwork, and Neutralize. Establish reliable poison and efficient block; cross 160 HP promptly and prepare strong single-card Ringing turns.
plan.summary: Add reliable poison before Accelerant, efficient defense, and draw. Remove Strikes after replacements. Use Pillow rests to maintain buffers; smith key cards when safe. Keep the planned elite for resources.
